goal: Make a finite banked inventory-recipe order from observed owned inputs for a named route consumer.
consumer: Woodpecker cuts a bounded batch of owned uncut sapphires into banked sapphires for the Overall route's twelve-ring shortage. Observe the actual bank first, retain reserved stock, and use explicit MAX_MAKE and CAP limits. Native proof invokes the actual cut-sapphire CLI and retains CRC-checked saves, exact input/output counts, source binding, preserved assets and confirmed logout. Other recipes need their own useful entry and acceptance.
